messages:
marie_cs: Quick sync — Nereid Labs dedicated bring-up plan. Target go-live: Tue 04/12 14:00 UTC. Need confirmation on quota + autoscale windows.
aj_devops: Thanks. Can you paste the quota numbers we're provisioning?
marie_cs: Allocated pool = 8 GPUs, soft quota 120k tokens/min, hard quota 160k tokens/min. Warmup traffic planned 12h prior.
sam_reliability: Suggest we set autoscale floor=4, ceiling=12, scale_step=2, cooldown=3m. Avoid rapid oscillation during ramp.
lee_se: We're running customer-specific prompt set — expect avg seq len 512. That changes batching profile.
marie_cs: Noted. @aj_devops can you confirm runtime image will have KV cache priming enabled? Also need cert for private logs.
aj_devops: KV priming on. Image tag: redwood/runtime:2026-03-18-priming. Logs -> s3://nereid-prod-logs (IAM role attached).
ops-bot: Warmup job queued by marie_cs. JobID: warmup-2068123456-1. ETA: 12h.
nora_ce: We'll run load tests Friday window 09:00-11:00 UTC. Plan: closed-loop ramp 0 -> 80% soft quota over 40m, hold 20m, spike tests 120% for 5m. I'll post the script.
marie_cs: Please include error budget checks and fallback policy test (model fallback + 429 handling).
nora_ce: Will include. Sample curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model": "rwd-7b-q8", "input": "<prompt>"}'
```
sam_reliability: Add an alert on p50 latency > 200ms for >5min and on error rate >2% over 5m.
lee_se: Also validate that training KV cache is being populated — check /metrics?cache_hits.
aj_devops: I'll wire up dashboards. Also pre-warm: run priming workload for top-10 prefixes (nora_ce to provide list).
marie_cs: FYI renewal risk flagged: if we miss <1s p95 target during go-live, CS will escalate. Let's keep canary traffic first 15m.
aj_devops: Canary config: 5% traffic routed to canary group with health probe every 30s. Auto-rollback on >1% 5m error.
ops-bot: Deploy to dedicated pool started. DeploymentID: dep-2068123456-a. Status: building.
marie_cs: Thanks all — will post final runbook + zoom dial tomorrow. :thumbsup:
